entities.summary: Leticia Boscacci is an Argentine volleyball player who participated with the Argentina national team at the Pan-American Volleyball Cup, the FIVB Volleyball World Grand Prix, the FIVB Volleyball Women's World Cup, the 2014 FIVB Volleyball Women's World Championship in Italy, the 2015 Pan American Games in Canada, and the 2016 Summer Olympics in Brazil.
